authority: Cloudflare official documentation current as of 2026-10-05

create_undeployed_version: Fetch exact current Worker script content and current version/settings before mutation.
Upload a new version with POST /accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts/{script_name}/versions.
For an existing Worker whose current static assets must be preserved exactly, set metadata keep_assets=true. Do not require or reconstruct an asset manifest/JWT.
Use exact inherited bindings from the known current version and bindings_inherit=strict when inherit bindings are used, so unresolved bindings fail closed.
Do not deploy as part of version upload.
verify_before_deploy: Preferred: use the candidate Version URL when reachable.
Fallback when Version URL is unavailable or blocked: create a split deployment with the exact current version at 100% traffic and the candidate at 0% traffic.
Use the Cloudflare-Workers-Version-Overrides header against the normal production route to force ONLY the verification request to the 0% candidate version.
Verify exact response bytes/identity for the changed route plus representative unchanged routes/assets and confirm the override actually selected the candidate version.
Do not send any ordinary traffic percentage to the candidate during smoke testing.
deploy: Deploy the exact verified version by version ID.
Preserve the exact prior version/deployment ID as rollback anchor.
rollback: Rollback to the exact prior Worker VERSION ID at 100% traffic.
Cloudflare rollback creates a new deployment; do not require the historical deployment ID itself to become active again.
Verify the restored active version ID and production behavior after rollback.

version_url_failure_fallback.normal_user_traffic: remains on exact current version at 100%
version_url_failure_fallback.requirement: candidate version must be included in the current split deployment at 0% before override requests can target it
version_url_failure_fallback.rollback_after_smoke: rollback or deploy the exact prior stable version ID to 100%; Cloudflare creates a NEW deployment object, so success criterion is exact prior VERSION restored at 100%, not reuse of the old deployment ID

selective_worker_first.accepted_forms: true or an array of route patterns
selective_worker_first.rule: Prefer exact updater paths; do not set run_worker_first globally unless a narrower selective configuration is impossible.
selective_worker_first.preserve_other_assets: All other paths remain asset-first and reuse the current asset set with keep_assets=true.

current_hbnf_application.recovery_need: temporarily make exact signed seq20 recovery manifest visible through the updater-consumed latest.json contract while preserving every existing static asset
current_hbnf_application.approved_mechanism_to_rehearse: If Version URL works, verify there. If it returns 403/1010 or is otherwise unavailable, use the documented 0%-traffic split deployment with current version 100% and candidate 0%, then force only smoke-test requests to candidate using Cloudflare-Workers-Version-Overrides. After verification, promote candidate only for the bounded recovery window; then rollback exact prior version ID to 100%.
forbidden: rebuild static assets from a stale local directory
assume an asset JWT must be recoverable from the existing version

current_preview_blocker.observed_behavior: Override request returned the stable seq19 static latest.json/latest.json.sig even when targeting the candidate at 0% because candidate assets are asset-first.
current_preview_blocker.root_cause: Candidate asset config has raw_run_worker_first=false and serve_directly=true; exact updater paths match preserved static assets so Worker code is bypassed.
current_preview_blocker.resolution: Create a replacement candidate version using the same keep_assets=true preservation path but configure assets.run_worker_first selectively for /firmware/matrix/stable/latest.json and /firmware/matrix/stable/latest.json.sig (or the narrowest wildcard proven necessary). Rehearse the replacement at 0% with version override before any device mutation.

official_doc_facts: Cloudflare Direct Uploads documents keep_assets=true specifically for reusing an existing Worker's static asset set without supplying a completion token.
Worker Versions capture code, static assets, bindings, and compatibility settings.
Version uploads can be created without deployment and tested via Version URLs.
Cloudflare supports deployment/rollback by exact Worker version ID.
